equivalence.scope: Existing saved successful rounds; does not prove bitwise generation determinism or speed. Optimization not installed in live worker.

benchmark_status.scope: Frozen recorded requests, responses not delivered; ABBA order microbenchmark, no claim of identical future speed. Main pending response is retained in socket while controller stopped.

decision: Keep original schedule. Warmed later comparison C-first16.203s vs baseline15.282s does not support a repeatable speed gain. Early differences are confounded by warming, and replayed fixed inputs do not reproduce growing history. No claimed production acceleration.
limitations: One ABBA frozen-request microbenchmark, not a study-wide randomized performance trial. Outputs were not delivered to market agents. Controller was suspended/resumed for about75seconds without changing sources or selecting/replacing market responses. Client call wall latencies may include this interval.
